faq.headline: Café Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your café site.

items.question: Can I change the menu as items sell out?
items.answer: Yes. Edit your menu copy and prices when they change. A live inventory or point-of-sale sync is not included.

items.question: Can people order and pay online?
items.answer: This page focuses on showing your menu and taking enquiries. Do not promise online ordering until a supported checkout and fulfilment flow is active.

items.question: Can I add a catering request form?
items.answer: You can collect catering enquiries through a contact form and follow up directly.

items.question: Can I add opening hours and directions?
items.answer: Yes. Add the current hours, address, and directions so customers can plan a visit. Update them when your schedule changes.

items.question: Can I include dietary or allergen information?
items.answer: You can add the information your café has verified. Keep it current and ask customers to confirm details with staff when they have an allergy or dietary concern.

items.question: Can customers ask about catering for an event?
items.answer: Yes. A contact form can collect the event date, guest count, and contact details. Your team confirms the menu, availability, and price directly.
